blocks.text:
Anthony Russell attacked Huntley with a metal bar while they were in a recycling workshop at HMP Frankland

A prisoner who bludgeoned the Soham killer Ian Huntley to death with a 4kg metal bar has been sentenced to a second whole-life term.

Anthony Russell was already serving a whole-life order for three murders. On Tuesday, he pleaded guilty to the murder of Huntley and was given the same sentence.
